sources.title: Annexure B - UDiFF Catalogue Version 4.0
relevant_sections: Field Master rows 347-350, 354, 357: OHLC, settlement and quantity definitions
Field Master row 396: exchange trade-status field
Field Master row 316: clearing-corporation obligation/confirmation status distinction
Standard Value List rows 25-29, 41: trade codes and stock-futures instrument code
sources.minimal_paraphrase: Daily high/low/close and total quantity are named separately. Exchange trade codes define statuses; clearing-corporation status remarks concern obligation computation, not bhavcopy OHLC inclusion.

relevant_sections: Bhavcopy File Format rows 16-19, 23, 26: F&O field applicability/precision
Trade File Format row 31; Standard Value List_latest rows 25-29: trade status
Complete Bhavcopy File Format field list: no per-row trade-status field
sources.minimal_paraphrase: F&O price fields have two-decimal guidance. Trade status is a trade-file field, not a bhavcopy row attribution field; aggregate inclusion rules are not supplied.

sources.publisher: National Stock Exchange of India Limited
sources.title: Equity Derivatives - Settlement Price
relevant_sections: Daily Settlement table: Index/Global index versus Individual Security futures
Un-expired illiquid futures: separate theoretical settlement
sources.minimal_paraphrase: Index futures use a last-half-hour weighted average on NSE; individual-security futures use an average across exchanges. Illiquid unexpired futures have a separate theoretical settlement basis. Exact UDiFF mapping and case applicability remain unproven.
